title: DHAS Notification 2026 - Walk-in interview for 05 Junior Resident Posts
description: The Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan (DHAS) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 05 Junior Resident Posts. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their MBBS can apply for the DHAS Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can attend the walk-in interview.
